abap.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate that validates your practical training in SAP ABAP development, covering everything from core programming to real-time project work.
abap.description: Our focus stays on making sure you can actually perform the job — the certificate is proof of that capability, not just attendance.
highlights: Certificate includes details of modules covered and project work completed
Recognised by our placement partners and industry network in Raipur and beyond
Optional guidance provided for those who wish to pursue official SAP certification exams
Certificate is issued only after project submission and final assessment

ariba.completionText: On successful completion of the SAP Ariba course in Raipur, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your hands-on training in Ariba Sourcing, Contracts, Procurement, and Supplier Management modules.
ariba.description: What the certificate reflects: Duration and modules completed, Practical/live project work undertaken, Skill areas covered during training. Additionally, our trainers will guide you on how to register for official SAP Ariba certification exams, exam pattern, structure, and preparation strategy, and building a certification-ready resume and LinkedIn profile.
highlights: Duration and modules completed
Practical/live project work undertaken
Guidance for official SAP Ariba certification exams

basis.completionText: On successful completion of this SAP Basis training in Raipur, you will receive a course completion certificate recognizing your practical training and project work.
basis.description: Our trainers also guide students who wish to pursue official SAP certification, helping them understand exam patterns, question types, and preparation strategy.
highlights: Verifiable course completion certificate from the institute
Detailed skill and module breakdown mentioned on the certificate
Guidance and preparation support for global SAP certification exams
Certificate adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile

fico.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your training in SAP FICO, including the modules covered and the practical project work completed.
fico.description: For learners aiming for official SAP certification, our trainers will guide you on exam pattern, preparation resources, and how our training curriculum maps to SAP's certification syllabus.
highlights: Certificate reflects your training hours, curriculum covered, and hands-on project completion
Useful to include on your resume and LinkedIn profile when applying for SAP FICO roles
Guidance for official SAP certification exam

ewm.completionText: Every student who completes the course, including the live project and assessments, receives a course completion certificate in SAP EWM. The certificate reflects the modules covered, project work completed, and the duration of training.
ewm.description: While this is not an official SAP certification, it is recognized by hiring partners and recruiters we work with in Raipur, and it strengthens your profile when applying for SAP EWM or logistics-related roles. For students who want to pursue the official SAP certification exam, our trainers provide additional guidance, sample questions, and exam-pattern practice as part of the mentorship support.
highlights: Modules covered, project work completed, and duration of training
Recognized by hiring partners and recruiters in Raipur
Guidance for official SAP certification exam

mm.completionText: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognising your training in SAP Materials Management.
mm.description: A completion certificate from a structured SAP MM Training in Raipur adds credibility to your resume and LinkedIn profile, especially when paired with the practical project work and case studies you complete during the course. For learners who wish to pursue the official SAP certification exam separately, our trainers also provide exam-oriented guidance and mock tests to help you prepare.
highlights: Modules covered and total training hours
Hands-on project work completed

bwbi.completionText: On successful completion of the course and project work, you will receive a verified SAP BW/BI course completion certificate that reflects your training duration and modules covered, hands-on project work completed during the course, a unique certificate ID for verification by employers, and recognition that supports your resume and LinkedIn profile.

highlights: Training duration and modules covered
Hands-on project work completed
Unique certificate ID for employer verification

successfactors.completionText: On successful completion of this SAP SuccessFactors course in Raipur, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognizing your training and project work.
successfactors.description: We also prepare you separately for the official SAP Certified Application Associate — SAP SuccessFactors exam (module-specific, e.g., Employee Central or Recruiting), which is administered by SAP directly and is the credential employers actually look for. What's included in certificate preparation: Structured mapping of course content to the official exam blueprint, Practice tests and mock exams, Guidance on exam registration and exam-day process.
highlights: Recognizing your training and project work
Structured mapping to official exam blueprint
Practice tests and mock exams
